solves.reasoning: (A) aims to ___ resources efficiently → allocate (할당). (B) perpetuating ___ and discrimination → bias (편향). (C) ___ trust → undermine (약화). 조합 ②.
(A) ___ policing where algorithms predict → predictive. (B) perpetuating bias and ___ → discrimination. (C) ___ tested to ensure → rigorously. 조합 ④.
(A) criticized for ___ bias → perpetuating (영구화). (B) may ___ target those areas → disproportionately (불균형). (C) leading to ___ surveillance → heightened (강화된). 조합 ①.
①efficiently 적절(효율적 할당). ②perpetuating 적절(편향 영구화). ③weakening은 부적절 — 원문은 reinforcing(강화). ④unjust 적절(부당한 결과). 정답 ③.
①predict 적절(범죄 예측). ②increase는 부적절 — 원문은 reduce(범죄 감소 목적). ③criticized 적절(비판받음). ④surveillance 적절(감시 강화). 정답 ②.
①biased 적절(편향 데이터). ②inequalities 적절(불평등). ③accuracy 적절(정확성). ④hastily는 부적절 — 원문은 carefully(신중). 정답 ④.
bias and ___ → discrimination(차별). particularly against minority communities가 차별 문맥 단서. 정답 ①.
heightened ___ and increased arrests → surveillance(감시). 흑인·라틴계 커뮤니티 표적 문맥. 정답 ③.
aims to ___ law enforcement resources more efficiently → allocate(할당). 자원+효율적+배분 문맥. 정답 ②.
perpetuating(영구화하는) ≈ maintaining(유지하는). eliminating/preventing/reducing는 모두 반대 방향. 정답 ④.
undermine(약화시키다) ≈ weaken(약화시키다). support/establish/promote는 반의어. 정답 ①.
reinforcing(강화하는) ≈ strengthening(강화하는). diminishing(줄이는)은 반의어, questioning/exposing은 다른 행위. 정답 ③.
unjust(부당한) ↔ equitable(공평한). unfair/biased/partial은 모두 유의어. 정답 ②.
heightened(고조된) ↔ diminished(줄어든). elevated/intensified/amplified는 모두 유의어. 정답 ①.
(A) disproportionately target = 동사 '표적으로 삼다'. (B) sales target = 명사 '목표'. 정답 ③.
close observation for monitoring activities by authority = surveillance(감시). prediction/allocation/bias는 관찰 행위 아님. 정답 ④.
bias and ___(discriminate) — and 병렬 명사 자리 → discrimination. 정답.
the ___(fair) and accuracy — the+명사+and+명사 병렬 → fairness. 정답.
reinforcing ___ — 편향 데이터가 강화하는 대상 = existing inequalities(기존 불평등). 정답 ②.
undermine ___ — perpetuate racial bias or undermine ___ 구조. 비평가들이 신뢰 훼손 우려 → trust in law enforcement. 정답 ③.
